```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's Director has dictatorial powers unique in the American Republic.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's regulatory harassment of local and regional banks advantages big banks and makes it harder for Americans to buy a home.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's one-size-fits-all approach to every issue threatens the diversity of the country's financial system and would leave the country with just a few enormous institutions, as in many European countries.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau is not abolished, it should be subjected to congressional appropriation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Consumer protection in the financial markets can be advanced through measures that are both effective and constitutional if the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau is subjected to congressional appropriation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Any settlements arising from statutory violations by financial institutions must be used to make whole the harmed consumers, with any remaining proceeds given to the general Treasury.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Diversion of settlement funds to politically-connected parties should be a criminal offense.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans believe that no financial institution is too big to fail.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for legislation to ensure that the problems of any financial institution can be resolved through the Bankruptcy Code.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Support for prudent regulation of the banking system to ensure that FDIC-regulated banks are properly capitalized and taxpayers are protected against bailouts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to the government's use of disparate impact theory in enforcing anti-discrimination laws with regard to lending.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
